description: At turn end, block with standing attention or the command to arm a watcher while work is in flight; allow the stop when a watcher is live. `lobstah hook stop --park` waits in the hook. Each hook runs `lobstah hook <event>`, which detects the session's role (helm, trap, or neither). Inert unless the helm or trap is signed on or the directory opts in. SessionStart announces the session id; SessionEnd stows a soaking session. PostToolUse runs `lobstah hook post-tool-use`: a soaking session's liveness and activity, throttled, inert elsewhere.
